content.short: Mantscription is an inscription protocol on Mantle Network enabling users to inscribe data and digital assets directly on-chain in the Bitcoin Ordinals style.
content.description: Mantscription brings the Bitcoin Ordinals-inspired inscription paradigm to the Mantle Network, allowing users to inscribe text, images, and data permanently on-chain without relying on off-chain storage. Each inscription is stored directly in Mantle transaction calldata, creating immutable on-chain digital artifacts. The protocol has spawned a collection ecosystem around Mantle-native inscriptions, with a marketplace for trading and a minting platform for creating new inscription collections on the network.
content.meta: Mantscription is an on-chain inscription protocol for creating and trading inscribed digital assets on Mantle. Discover Mantscription on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
